_comment: InnerTube client profiles, tried top to bottom until one returns a playable
Opus format. Copy this file to data/youtube-clients.json to override it
without rebuilding: when YouTube retires a client, editing JSON is the fix.
'context' is merged verbatim into the /youtubei/v1/player request body, so a
new client needs no Rust changes. 'headers' likewise. 'needsPlayerJs' marks
profiles whose URLs arrive scrambled and require signature/n descrambling,
which this crate cannot do — such a profile can be listed, but only after
every token-free one, and it will not produce a stream today.
Re-probed 2026-08-31 against yt-dlp 2026.08.30, which had just rewritten its
own client table for the same breakage. Two things changed under us:
ANDROID_VR died. yt-dlp's note: since 2026-08-17 every format it hands back
is 403'd, and a direct probe here answers LOGIN_REQUIRED. It was the head of
this ladder; removing it is correct, not a regression to undo.
VISIONOS appeared, and is now the only client that serves plain URLs with no
PO token and no player JS — yt-dlp made it the sole entry in its
_DEFAULT_JSLESS_CLIENTS and the head of its unauthenticated default. It is
the only profile here that fetched every reachable video probed.
IOS is pinned to 20.03.02 on purpose. yt-dlp moved to 21.26.4; that version
answers with SABR streams only, so the extractor finds no direct Opus format
and the profile is worse than useless. Do not 'update' it without probing.
TVHTML5 and WEB are gone. Both were probed again at yt-dlp's current
versions (TVHTML5 7.20260707.07.00 and 5.20260707 with the Cobalt agents,
WEB 2.20260708.00.00) and every one answers UNPLAYABLE token-free — they
need a PO token, which is why yt-dlp only reaches for them when signed in.
They never succeeded once, and each cost a round trip per fetch before the
yt-dlp fallback was allowed to run.
Also dead, tried and confirmed on earlier probes — do not re-add:
ANDROID_MUSIC, IOS_MUSIC and ANDROID_CREATOR answer LOGIN_REQUIRED,
WEB_EMBEDDED_PLAYER and TVHTML5_SIMPLY_EMBEDDED_PLAYER are retired, MWEB
answers UNPLAYABLE. What clears the bot check is visitorData, which the
extractor mints and injects into every profile.
